assessment.reading: Interpret sophisticated journalistic, cultural, analytical and public-discourse texts with source and framing awareness.
assessment.listening: Extract explicit claims, implicit assumptions, rhetorical strategies, source positions and uncertainty from expert media communication.
assessment.speaking: Analyse, challenge and explain competing narratives using precise C2+ discourse and culturally appropriate communication.
assessment.writing: Produce investigative-style analyses, public briefings, discourse critiques and evidence-based communication strategies.
assessment.decisionMaking: Evaluate source reliability, framing, uncertainty, audience effects and communication risks before selecting a response.
assessment.presentation: Communicate complex information and cultural issues accurately to diverse audiences while preserving nuance and attribution.

successCriteria: distinguishes verified information, attribution, interpretation, framing and opinion
uses advanced media, cultural and discourse vocabulary accurately and flexibly
recognises rhetorical framing, omission, emphasis and potential manipulation
evaluates source quality and uncertainty without overclaiming
constructs and critiques sophisticated public-discourse arguments
shifts naturally between journalistic, academic, professional and public registers
adapts communication to culturally diverse audiences and contexts
produces concise public-facing recommendations from complex information
responds effectively to high-pressure information and communication scenarios
integrates research, listening, analysis, speaking and writing at C2+ level
